# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tariff_periods = [
    "2017-H1", "2017-H2", "2018-H1", "2018-H2", "2019-H1", "2019-H2",
    "2020-H1", "2020-H2", "2021-H1", "2021-H2", "2022-H1", "2022-H2",
    "2023-H1", "2023-H2", "2024-H1"
]
us_tariff = [3.1, 3.1, 3.8, 12.0, 18.3, 21.0, 19.3, 19.3, 19.3, 19.3, 19.3, 19.3, 19.3, 19.3, 25.4]
cn_tariff = [8.0, 8.0, 8.0, 16.5, 20.7, 21.8, 20.9, 20.9, 20.9, 20.9, 21.1, 21.1, 21.2, 21.2, 23.1]

def period_to_date(p):
    year, half = p.split("-")
    month = 1 if half == "H1" else 7
    return datetime(int(year), month, 1)

tariff_dates = [period_to_date(p) for p in tariff_periods]

trade_years = [2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]
us_exports = [115.6, 129.9, 120.3, 106.4, 124.5, 151.1, 153.8, 147.8, 138.2]
us_imports = [462.6, 505.5, 539.5, 452.2, 435.4, 506.4, 536.8, 427.2, 401.5]
total_bilateral = [578.2, 635.4, 659.8, 558.6, 559.9, 657.5, 690.6, 575.0, 539.7]

sc_years = [2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]
china_share = [21.4, 21.6, 21.2, 18.1, 18.6, 17.9, 16.5, 13.9, 12.8]
vietnam_share = [2.1, 2.2, 2.6, 2.9, 3.4, 3.7, 3.9, 4.5, 4.9]
india_share = [2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.3, 2.7, 2.8, 3.1, 3.4]

policy_events = [
    ("2017-08-14", "Section 301\nInvestigation", "investigation"),
    ("2018-03-22", "Section 301\nMemo ($50B)", "tariff"),
    ("2018-07-06", "List 1: 25%\non $34B", "tariff"),
    ("2018-08-23", "List 2: 25%\non $16B", "tariff"),
    ("2018-09-24", "List 3: 10%\non $200B", "tariff"),
    ("2019-05-10", "List 3→25%\non $200B", "tariff"),
    ("2019-09-01", "List 4A: 15%\non $112B", "tariff"),
    ("2020-01-15", "Phase One\nDeal Signed", "deal"),
    ("2020-02-14", "Phase One\nReductions", "deal"),
    ("2021-10-04", "USTR Tariff\nReview", "review"),
    ("2022-06-20", "Biden Considers\nExclusions", "review"),
    ("2024-05-14", "Biden: EVs 100%,\nSemis 50%", "tariff"),
]
event_dates = [datetime.strptime(e[0], "%Y-%m-%d") for e in policy_events]
event_labels = [e[1] for e in policy_events]
event_cats = [e[2] for e in policy_events]

# ── Style ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "sans-serif",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "figure.facecolor": "#FAFAF8",
    "axes.facecolor": "#FAFAF8",
    "text.color": "#2C2C2C",
    "axes.labelcolor": "#2C2C2C",
    "xtick.color": "#666666",
    "ytick.color": "#666666",
})

C_US_TARIFF = "#B22234"      # muted red
C_CN_TARIFF = "#2B5C8A"      # steel blue
C_CHINA = "#C0392B"           # red for china
C_VIETNAM = "#1A8A6E"        # teal green
C_INDIA = "#D4870E"          # amber
C_EXPORT = "#5B7FA5"         # steel
C_IMPORT = "#B22234"         # red
C_TOTAL = "#2C2C2C"          # dark
C_DEAL = "#27AE60"
C_REVIEW = "#8E44AD"
C_INVEST = "#7F8C8D"

event_color_map = {"tariff": C_US_TARIFF, "deal": C_DEAL, "review": C_REVIEW, "investigation": C_INVEST}

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 16), dpi=150)
fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=0.32, top=0.93, bottom=0.04, left=0.10, right=0.88)

fig.suptitle(
    "US–China Trade War: Tariff Escalation, Bilateral Trade,\nand Supply Chain Divergence (2016–2024)",
    fontsize=15, fontweight="bold", y=0.97, color="#1A1A1A"
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 1: Tariff Rates (step chart) + policy event annotations
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(3, 1, 1)

ax1.step(tariff_dates, us_tariff, where="mid", color=C_US_TARIFF, linewidth=2.2, label="US tariff on Chinese goods", zorder=3)
ax1.step(tariff_dates, cn_tariff, where="mid", color=C_CN_TARIFF, linewidth=2.2, label="China tariff on US goods", zorder=3)
ax1.fill_between(tariff_dates, us_tariff, alpha=0.08, color=C_US_TARIFF, step="mid")
ax1.fill_between(tariff_dates, cn_tariff, alpha=0.08, color=C_CN_TARIFF, step="mid")

# Annotate policy events
y_positions_us = []
y_positions_cn = []
for i, (ed, el, ec) in enumerate(zip(event_dates, event_labels, event_cats)):
    col = event_color_map[ec]
    # Stagger labels vertically to avoid overlap
    cycle = i % 4
    y_us = 27 + cycle * 2.5
    ax1.annotate(
        el, xy=(ed, 26), xytext=(ed, y_us),
        fontsize=6.2, color=col, ha="center", va="bottom",
        fontweight="bold" if ec == "tariff" else "normal",
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=col, lw=0.6),
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc="white", ec=col, lw=0.4, alpha=0.85),
        zorder=5
    )

ax1.set_ylabel("Avg. Effective Tariff Rate (%)", fontweight="bold")
ax1.set_ylim(0, 38)
ax1.set_xlim(datetime(2017, 1, 1), datetime(2024, 9, 1))
ax1.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%Y"))
ax1.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5, edgecolor="#CCCCCC")
ax1.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3, linestyle="--")
ax1.set_title("Tariff Escalation & Key Policy Milestones", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=10, loc="left")

# Category legend for event markers
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
event_legend = ax1.legend(
    [Patch(fc=C_US_TARIFF, ec=C_US_TARIFF, alpha=0.7, label="Tariff action"),
     Patch(fc=C_DEAL, ec=C_DEAL, alpha=0.7, label="Deal / reduction"),
     Patch(fc=C_REVIEW, ec=C_REVIEW, alpha=0.7, label="Review / consideration"),
     Patch(fc=C_INVEST, ec=C_INVEST, alpha=0.7, label="Investigation")],
    ["Tariff action", "Deal / reduction", "Review", "Investigation"],
    loc="center right", fontsize=7, frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="#CCCCCC",
    title="Event type", title_fontsize=7
)
# Also keep the tariff line legend
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5, edgecolor="#CCCCCC")
ax1.add_artist(event_legend)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 2: Bilateral Trade Volume
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(3, 1, 2)

bar_w = 0.35
x_pos = np.array(trade_years)

bars_import = ax2.bar(x_pos - bar_w/2, us_imports, bar_w, color=C_IMPORT, alpha=0.75, label="US imports from China", zorder=3)
bars_export = ax2.bar(x_pos + bar_w/2, us_exports, bar_w, color=C_EXPORT, alpha=0.75, label="US exports to China", zorder=3)
line_total, = ax2.plot(x_pos, total_bilateral, color=C_TOTAL, linewidth=2.2, marker="o", markersize=5, label="Total bilateral trade", zorder=4)

# Highlight the dip during peak tariff period
ax2.axvspan(2018.5, 2020.5, alpha=0.07, color="#C0392B", zorder=1)
ax2.annotate("Peak tariff\nperiod", xy=(2019.5, 558), fontsize=7.5, color="#C0392B",
             ha="center", fontstyle="italic", alpha=0.8)

# Partial recovery annotation
ax2.annotate("Partial\nrecovery", xy=(2021.5, 674), fontsize=7.5, color="#2C2C2C",
             ha="center", fontstyle="italic", alpha=0.6)

ax2.set_ylabel("Billion USD", fontweight="bold")
ax2.set_ylim(0, 780)
ax2.set_xlim(2015.5, 2024.5)
ax2.set_xticks(trade_years)
ax2.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5, edgecolor="#CCCCCC")
ax2.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3, linestyle="--")
ax2.set_title("US–China Bilateral Trade Volume", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=10, loc="left")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 3: Supply Chain Share
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(3, 1, 3)

ax3.plot(sc_years, china_share, color=C_CHINA, linewidth=2.5, marker="o", markersize=5, label="China", zorder=4)
ax3.fill_between(sc_years, china_share, alpha=0.10, color=C_CHINA, zorder=2)

ax3.plot(sc_years, vietnam_share, color=C_VIETNAM, linewidth=2.2, marker="s", markersize=4.5, label="Vietnam", zorder=4)
ax3.fill_between(sc_years, vietnam_share, alpha=0.10, color=C_VIETNAM, zorder=2)

ax3.plot(sc_years, india_share, color=C_INDIA, linewidth=2.2, marker="^", markersize=4.5, label="India", zorder=4)
ax3.fill_between(sc_years, india_share, alpha=0.10, color=C_INDIA, zorder=2)

# Highlight acceleration after 2018
ax3.axvspan(2018.5, 2024.5, alpha=0.05, color=C_VIETNAM, zorder=1)
ax3.annotate("Post-2018\nacceleration", xy=(2021, 4.5), fontsize=8, color=C_VIETNAM,
             fontweight="bold", ha="center", alpha=0.7)

# Annotate key values
ax3.annotate(f"{china_share[0]:.1f}%", xy=(2016, china_share[0]), xytext=(-15, 8),
             textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8, color=C_CHINA, fontweight="bold")
ax3.annotate(f"{china_share[-1]:.1f}%", xy=(2024, china_share[-1]), xytext=(5, 5),
             textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8, color=C_CHINA, fontweight="bold")
ax3.annotate(f"{vietnam_share[-1]:.1f}%", xy=(2024, vietnam_share[-1]), xytext=(5, 5),
             textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8, color=C_VIETNAM, fontweight="bold")
ax3.annotate(f"{india_share[-1]:.1f}%", xy=(2024, india_share[-1]), xytext=(5, -12),
             textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8, color=C_INDIA, fontweight="bold")

ax3.set_ylabel("Share of US Imports (%)", fontweight="bold")
ax3.set_xlabel("Year", fontweight="bold")
ax3.set_ylim(0, 26)
ax3.set_xlim(2015.5, 2024.8)
ax3.set_xticks(sc_years)
ax3.legend(loc="center right", frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5, edgecolor="#CCCCCC")
ax3.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3, linestyle="--")
ax3.set_title("Supply Chain Divergence: Share of US Goods Imports", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=10, loc="left")

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
